data.body_html:
If you're looking for a no license boat rental in Marbella, prices in 2043 start at €749 for 2 hours on our Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. That price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA – so you won't face any surprise costs. Whether you want a quick spin along the coast or a full day exploring Cala del Faro, here's exactly what you'll pay.

Why You Don't Need a Licence

In Spain, renting a boat without a licence is perfectly legal – as long as a licensed skipper is on board. Every boat in our fleet comes with a professional skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You simply relax, sunbathe, and enjoy the views of La Concha and the Golden Mile. No paperwork, no exams, no stress.

No License Boat Rental Marbella Prices 2043 – Tier A

Our most popular no-license options are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer the same pricing:

DurationPrice
2 hours€749
4 hours€1,399
6 hours€1,899
8 hours€2,299

All prices include skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and IVA. No hidden fees.

Premium Option: Mangusta 80 – €4,719 for 4 Hours

For a more luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) is available at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. This price includes a free jet ski – perfect for exploring the coast at your own pace. You can also choose the grey variant, identical in price and inclusions. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

Other Boats – Pricing on Request

We have a full fleet of no-license boats, but prices for most are on request via WhatsApp. This includes:

  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax)
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax)
  • Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax)
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax)
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax)
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax)
  • Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax)
  • Red Tide (11m, 6 pax)
  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax)
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax)
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax)

Contact us on WhatsApp for a tailored quote based on your group size and itinerary.

What Affects the Price?

Several factors influence the final cost of a no-license boat rental in Marbella:

  • Boat size and model – larger yachts cost more.
  • Duration – longer charters offer better hourly rates.
  • Season – peak summer (June–September) is more expensive.
  • Extras – jet skis, water toys, or catering can be added.

Our Tier A pricing is fixed, so you can book with confidence.

Hidden Costs to Avoid

With us, there are none. Fuel, port fees, insurance, and IVA are all included. Some operators quote low prices then add on fuel and cleaning fees – we don't. The price you see is the price you pay. For a transparent breakdown, see our [boat rental Marbella prices](/blog/) guide.

How to Book Your No-License Charter

Booking is simple:

  1. Choose your boat – Tier A for fixed pricing, or contact us for others.
  2. Pick your date and duration (2h, 4h, 6h, 8h).
  3. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm availability and secure your booking.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you're right in the heart of Marbella's marina life. After your trip, you can explore the Golden Mile or grab a bite at a beach club.

Popular Itineraries for No-License Rentals

With a skipper at the helm, you can choose your own route. Popular options include:

  • Marbella to Cabopino – 30 minutes east, with a stop at Cala del Faro.
  • Marbella to Estepona – 45 minutes west, passing Cala Cortés.
  • Marbella to Sotogrande – a longer trip for full-day charters.

Your skipper will advise on the best spots for swimming and snorkelling based on weather conditions.
